entropy.text: The weather has gone insane: freak storms, raining fish, snow in the desert.

final_cut.story:
Beat 1: 20935 of the Pensioners of Abidjan leave Abidjan for Yaoundé: Time's circle has passed them by; meanwhile In Tokyo the Cathedral clergy of Tokyo found the Quiet Flame of Death.
Beat 2: 22269 of the Vergers and acolytes of Johannesburg leave Johannesburg for Pretoria: Time's circle has passed them by; meanwhile 5246 of the Pickpockets of Kinshasa leave Kinshasa for Nairobi: Time's circle has passed them by.
Beat 3: Juniper tries to shout someone, and 3 more things went sideways.
Beat 4: 30872 of the Stevedores of Honiara leave Honiara for Port Moresby: Time's circle has passed them by; meanwhile 17729 of the Corner grocers of Ōsaka leave Ōsaka for Shanghai: Time's circle has passed them by.
Beat 5: 19803 of the Night orderlies of Shanghai leave Shanghai for Manila: Time's circle has passed them by; meanwhile 13114 of the Hospital nurses of Kolkata leave Kolkata for Bangkok: Time's circle has passed them by.
Beat 6: In Cairo the harvest fails; meanwhile 19259 of the Hospital nurses of Manila leave Manila for Bangkok: Time's circle has passed them by.
Beat 7: Time's clock catches Juniper outside the arena, and 11 more things went sideways.
Beat 8: Time's clock catches Rook outside the arena, and 11 more things went sideways.
final_cut.title: Final Night 7

piles.name: Rook
piles.statue_prompt: An amiibo-style collectible figure of the demigod Rook, frozen mid-fall (fell on the Final Night), on a round base shaped like South-Eastern Asia, atop a ridiculous towering pile of everything they held and summoned: take. Tiny figures of the people they touched cling to the pile: nobody. Two glowing hands hover at their sides.
